review.notes: Machine-drafted by an AI model; awaiting native-speaker review. For the Honduran reviewer: first-person present testimonies in very simple Spanish ("Creo en Dios", "Dios me ama", "tengo paz"); the faith statements are the drafter's own simple wording and need a church-competent Honduran reviewer; "cristiano / cristiana"; "Gracias a Dios".

english.source: drafted with the text; not reviewed

sentences.text: Hoy hay una reunión en la iglesia.
sentences.english: Today there is a meeting at the church.

sentences.text: La iglesia es pequeña, pero viene mucha gente.
sentences.english: The church is small, but many people come.

sentences.text: Hay café y pan para todos.
sentences.english: There is coffee and bread for everyone.

sentences.speaker: pastor
sentences.english: Today we talk about our lives.

sentences.speaker: pastor
sentences.text: Dios, gracias por la gente de esta iglesia.
sentences.english: God, thank you for the people of this church.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Mi familia está lejos de aquí.
sentences.english: My family is far from here.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Mi papá y mi mamá están en su casa.
sentences.english: My dad and my mom are at their house.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Hablo con mi mamá en el teléfono.
sentences.english: I talk with my mom on the phone.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: I write messages to my brother.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Mi vida es nueva en Honduras.
sentences.english: My life is new in Honduras.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Mi cuarto nuevo está cerca de la iglesia.
sentences.english: My new room is near the church.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Pero la gente es muy buena.
sentences.english: But the people are very good.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Doña Marta hace sopa y pan para mí.
sentences.english: Doña Marta makes soup and bread for me.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Luis y Ana me ayudan con el español.
sentences.english: Luis and Ana help me with Spanish.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Los vecinos hablan español todos los días.
sentences.english: The neighbours speak Spanish every day.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Doña Marta y Nico son mi familia aquí.
sentences.english: Doña Marta and Nico are my family here.

sentences.speaker: elena
sentences.text: Tengo una pulpería cerca de la terminal.
sentences.english: I have a shop near the terminal.

sentences.speaker: elena
sentences.text: El pastor y el equipo vienen a visitar.
sentences.english: The pastor and the team come to visit.

sentences.speaker: elena
sentences.text: Los vecinos vienen a mi pulpería.
sentences.english: The neighbours come to my shop.

sentences.speaker: elena
sentences.text: Siempre hay gente en la calle.
sentences.english: There are always people in the street.

sentences.speaker: elena
sentences.text: El pastor y el equipo oran por mí.
sentences.english: The pastor and the team pray for me.

sentences.speaker: nico
sentences.english: God, thank you for my backpack.

sentences.speaker: nico
sentences.text: Necesito tu ayuda en la escuela.
sentences.english: I need your help at school.

sentences.speaker: nico
sentences.english: My brother Luis is a teacher.

sentences.speaker: nico
sentences.english: My sister Ana is a nurse.

sentences.speaker: nico
sentences.text: Mi abuela vende pan y tamales.
sentences.english: My grandma sells bread and tamales.

sentences.speaker: pastor
sentences.text: Dios es bueno con los cristianos y con los vecinos.
sentences.english: God is good to Christians and to neighbours.

sentences.text: Ahora todos toman café y comen pan.
sentences.english: Now everyone has coffee and eats bread.

sentences.speaker: mario
sentences.text: Mi familia quiere hablar con vos.
sentences.english: My family wants to talk with you.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Voy a visitar a su familia.
sentences.english: I am going to visit your family.

sentences.speaker: karla
sentences.text: Mi mamá hace baleadas muy buenas.
sentences.english: My mom makes very good baleadas.
